r2.conclusion: The old positive signal was produced by a T2 kill of a threat captured at the T1 root. That delayed kill must not count as removing the current public threat; current code now evaluates the pre-EndTurn snapshot of the root turn.

nextFixture.rule: The proven threat must be removed during the current root turn before EndTurn, and its remaining durability should equal the local attack's actual damage D so alternative targets preserve the same pre-carry EnemyHp key.
nextFixture.starterIroncladExample: Use a current-turn Strike/Bash whose actual damage exactly matches an AllPlayers threat's remaining durability; keep an Unknown/non-attacking alternative target above that damage.
nextFixture.retryLimit: At most one additional ordinary multi-enemy fixture if the first exact-damage fixture remains UNVERIFIED.
